description: Store an LLM provider API key in the OS keyring (Windows Credential Manager / Keychain / Secret Service). Validates the key against the provider's free probe by default. The key value is never returned by any tool.

provider.description: Canonical provider id: anthropic, openai, google, deepseek, minimax, minimax-cn, zhipu, moonshot, qwen.

validate.description: Run the free probe (GET /models) before storing. Default true.

name: dark_memory_llm_key_add
